items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Marla (phonetic spelling) got on the case and my secretary--he belonged to both of them

ctx.x: No. That's when he turned and said, the hell with the union and this and that and so on and really, Marla (phonetic spelling) got on the case and my secretary--he belonged to both of them--it's not even over now--one guy is a lobbyist for the union, although it doesn't look like our lobbyist is going to do a darn thing, is on the case. They think it was a payoff some kind of way.
We're not saying that he was right, Ernie Fields had to win, but how could he win and denounce him.
